tasks.summary.title: Material summary
tasks.summary.purpose: Read the primary materials together, use context materials to aid interpretation, and return sections with material-level sources.
tasks.summary.fields.language: Output language name or tag, such as French or fr. Defaults to Simplified Chinese.
tasks.summary.fields.maxSections: Maximum section count, default 6. Empty source content may produce zero sections.
tasks.summary.fields.focus: Focus for this request, at most 2000 characters; null or omitted means organize around the materials.
tasks.summary.fields.title: Summary title, from 1 to 200 characters.
tasks.summary.fields.sections: Sections in reading order, no more than this request's maxSections.
tasks.summary.fields.heading: Section heading, from 1 to 160 characters.
tasks.summary.fields.markdown: Section body in Markdown, from 1 to 20000 characters.
tasks.summary.fields.sourceKeys: One to 64 source keys supporting this section, selected from this request's S1, S2 and other entries in first-reference order.
tasks.summary.fields.notes: Relevant missing material, source disagreement or processing notes; empty when no note is needed, at most 4000 characters.
tasks.summary.rules.sectionCount: The section count does not exceed this request's maxSections.
tasks.summary.rules.sourceKeys: Every source key exists in this request's source directory.
tasks.summary.rules.uniqueKeys: Source keys are unique within each section.
tasks.summary.errors.sectionCount: The section count {{actual}} exceeds this request's limit {{max}}.
tasks.summary.errors.unknownSource: Source key {{key}} is absent from this request's source directory.
tasks.summary.errors.duplicateSource: Source key {{key}} is repeated in the same section.
